clips.title: The story
paras: The Old Port Authority is a bustling, multi-vendor warehouse nestled along the boardwalks of Booty Bay. Beneath its roof, travelers browse everything from exotic pets and firearms to hearty rations and finely crafted weapons.

Perched inside the pirate haven of Booty Bay, the Old Port Authority serves as an indoor marketplace divided into distinct stalls, and its interior buzzes with brisk commerce. Merchants hawk general adventuring supplies, firearms, bows, food, and weapons to scoundrels and privateers alike. It also houses exotic imports, offering colorful birds and nautical oddities straight off the docks to anyone with coin.
